{{Location infobox | name = Camp Rankor | image = [[File:Camp Rankor.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Prophecies | region = Southern Shiverpeaks | type = Outpost | partysize = 8 | exits = [[Snake Dance]]
[[Talus Chute]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y | storage upgrades = y | pic1 = [[File:Camp Rankor from Droknar's Forge.jpg|thumb|250px]] | pic1-text = Camp Rankor from Droknar's Forge }} Camp Rankor is a small, Stone Summit controlled outpost nestled between explorable areas [[Snake Dance]] and [[Talus Chute]]. {{Quotation|game| Named after the [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf]] Rankor Ironwill who was known for his extreme intolerance of other races, Camp Rankor had its immoral beginnings as a slave labor camp. Although it is still used to house some of its slaves, the Summit use it largely as a staging area for launching raids against the [[Deldrimor Dwarves]]. }} ==Getting there== From [[Droknar's Forge]], travel through [[Talus Chute]] heading North-West and then just North. ==NPCs== ===Services=== *{{x}} 20 [[Krogur]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Steig]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ===Henchmen=== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Lina]] (Protector) *{{n}} [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} [[Orion]] (Mage) ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *Its main use is as a running stop for people getting a run to [[Droknar's Forge]], and as a place to get a run up to the [[Deldrimor War Camp]]. *[[Steig]] doesn't have a [[Signet of Capture]] among his skills. ==Trivia== *The camp's name might be a variation of [http://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rancor rancor], likely a common emotion among the Stone Summit. *Also, a Rancor is a large beast from the Star Wars saga, which is seen in the beginning of Episode 6 - Return of the Jedi, in Jabba's Palace. {{gw2w|Rankor Ruins}} {{Towns and outposts in the Southern Shiverpeaks}}
